name: slatemark
description: No signals. Receipts. Read-only delayed market data and a trade journal for Codex. The AI creates each response using Slatemark's remote MCP tools and user-installed skills. A Slatemark account is required; Free includes one constrained MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Use Slatemark for approximately 15-minute-delayed market data, macro data, filings, framework rules, and your trade journal. Your AI client creates each response from Slatemark's remote MCP tools and skills you chose to install; Slatemark hosts no model. Brokerage, order, trading, and funds access is read-only. Journal writes are limited to user-authored records in your Slatemark store. Nothing here is personalized investment advice. A Slatemark account is required.
defaultPrompt: What is the latest delayed quote and recent trend for AAPL?
Which published AAPL filings and FOMC dates fall within the next 30 days?
Add a note to my journal that I opened a starter position in MSFT.
